title: ArchLex: Ask Claude to diagram your cloud
excerpt: Ask Claude, Cursor, or Codex to diagram AWS, GCP, or Kubernetes. ArchLex validates semantics and renders official-icon SVG. No API key.
content_html:
Open source · Claude, Cursor, Codex

Diagrams that know what they mean.

Ask your agent to diagram AWS, GCP, or Kubernetes. ArchLex validates the architecture and renders official-icon SVG you can read, diff, and share.

Built for AI agents.

Give Claude, Cursor, and other agents cloud architecture expertise. The ArchLex MCP server validates diagrams against AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes rules with zero hallucinated resource names or invalid relationships.

Provider-aware validation

441 cloud resources

No API key required

Connect in seconds

Register ArchLex as a remote HTTP server.

claude mcp add --transport http archlex https://mcp.archlex.dev/mcp

Add this server to .cursor/mcp.json.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "archlex": {
      "url": "https://mcp.archlex.dev/mcp"
    }
  }
}

Add ArchLex to the shared Codex MCP configuration.

codex mcp add archlex --url https://mcp.archlex.dev/mcp

Add this server to .vscode/mcp.json.

{
  "servers": {
    "archlex": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://mcp.archlex.dev/mcp"
    }
  }
}

Use this URL in any client that supports remote Streamable HTTP.

https://mcp.archlex.dev/mcp

Or let your agent set it up for you.

Set up the ArchLex MCP server for this project using the official remote Streamable HTTP endpoint at https://mcp.archlex.dev/mcp. Verify the connection, list the available ArchLex tools, and tell me when it is ready. Do not change unrelated MCP servers.

Then ask:

Design a resilient AWS event ingestion system, validate it, and open the result in ArchLex Playground.

Full MCP documentation

Official agent skill.

Equip Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and any AI coding assistant supporting the open SKILLS.md standard with deep cloud architecture diagramming and semantic validation.

Agent Skill Install (SKILLS.md)

npx skills add baires/archlex

Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and AGENTS.md / SKILLS.md agents

MCP tool workflows

Step-by-step workflow for render_diagram, validate_diagram, and catalog lookups directly within your coding agent session.

DSL reference & rules

Complete syntax rules, relationship kinds, containment scopes (accounts, regions, VPCs, subnets), and diagnostic resolution.

Working templates

Production-ready AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes templates that any AI agent can immediately adapt, validate, and extend.

Open source. Embed anywhere.

Lightweight, modular packages for browser and Node.js. Zero native binary dependencies.

Browser + Node.jsAWS · GCP · KubernetesMIT LicensedStrict TypeScript

npm install @archlex/core @archlex/aws @archlex/gcp @archlex/k8s
import { render } from "@archlex/core";
import { awsProvider } from "@archlex/aws";

const result = await render(source, {
  providers: [awsProvider],
  validation: "normal",
});

document.querySelector("#diagram").innerHTML = result.svg;

Open source · MIT licensed · No account required

See your architecture clearly.
